test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'STATE' is written as '38401405' and 'EXILE' is written as 5489245'. How will ‘ARENA’ be written in that language?
solution:
Here, the alphabets and their positions are shown as below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/488bd8b48f1c52f6ca1704276427898a3e041ff25050699d6149b321dfebfc59.png] 

The logic here is: The consonants letters position number are multiplied by 2 and vowels letters position number are written as it is. 

'STATE' is written as '38401405'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b5bab81e18fc0e1a1f1e0ed2b08985e4f9895fb396e319ec485329f20186537.png] 

And,

'EXILE' is written as 5489245'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfc9dd2a7d8bf7d2503e8507e7cdc738b3aa151e4fe67a0d8cd6c4cac68f3d5b.png] 

Similarly,

‘ARENA’ be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c02c976cd75324be345617c160fb1d940644e34caaf66268d4298487d68dcaf.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"1365281".**
